name: Noir 3D
description: Dark rooms with ONE light, faceless figures, typewriter dates and evidence cards. Quiet and uneasy.
rules: One light source per scene; everything else falls into darkness.
Red means the subject. Nothing else is red except evidence marks (stamp, circle, string).
No faces, no gore, no weapons shown; facts checked against primary sources and listed.
Slow: 3 to 5 s shots, push-ins and drifts only; longer pauses between sentences.
Captions typewriter, sentence case, cream with one red word.
camera_language: Slow push-in or drift; wide lens (fov 55+) in dark rooms; never inside the light cone.
audio_direction: tension drone, one hard hit at the turn, quiet room tone, no cheerful sounds
pitfalls: Camera inside the light cone gives a flat brown frame.
Seats or walls between camera and subject.
Too tight on a dark doorway reads as an empty frame.
